propId: Identifier of the property from which the element obtains its section or constitutive data.
matId: Material identifier used to retrieve the constitutive data.
elemId: Identifier of the element addressed by this record.
nodeId: Identifier of the grid point addressed by this record.
nodeSetId: Identifier of the set supplying the grid points.
node: Grid point to which this entry applies.
pointId: Identifier of the point to which this entry applies.
frameId: Coordinate system in which this entry is expressed.
positionFrameId: Coordinate system used to interpret the position coordinates.
displacementFrameId: Coordinate system in which the displacement components are expressed.
matFrameId: Coordinate system defining the material directions.
superelementId: Identifier of the superelement associated with the entry.
regionId: Identifier of the region on which the definition acts.
designVarId: Identifier of the design variable supplying the independent value.
tableId: Identifier of the tabulated function to evaluate.
parameterName: Selects the setting to assign. Use the spelling from this card’s parameter list.
parameterValue: Value assigned to the named parameter. Its interpretation depends on that name.
userRoutineName: Name used to identify the user-supplied routine.
structuralDamping: Structural damping coefficient for the associated material or property.
referenceTemperature: Temperature defining the reference state for these data, in the model’s temperature scale.
youngsModulus: Uniaxial elastic stress divided by uniaxial elastic strain (force per area).
shearModulus: Elastic shear stress divided by engineering shear strain (force per area).
bulkModulus: Resistance to volumetric compression, expressed as pressure.
poissonRatio: Negative ratio of transverse strain to axial strain under uniaxial stress (dimensionless).
tensionAllowable: Allowable tensile stress, in force per area.
compressionAllowable: Allowable compressive stress, in force per area.
shearAllowable: Allowable shear stress, in force per area.
thermalExpansion: Coefficient relating free thermal strain to a temperature change (inverse temperature).
thickness: Through-thickness dimension, in model length units.
radius: Radial dimension measured from the centre or axis (length).
area: Surface or cross-sectional measure, in squared model length units.
torsionConstant: Section constant multiplying the shear modulus in torsional rigidity (length to the fourth power).
scaleFactor: Multiplier applied to the quantity specified by the entry.
label: Text identifying the entry to the user or to records which select it by label.
fieldName: Name of the field addressed by this entry.
realValue: Real scalar value or real part of the complex quantity.
imaginaryValue: Imaginary part paired with the real component.
orientationNode: Grid point defining the orientation direction in place of explicit vector components.
orientation1: First component of the vector defining the element orientation.
orientation2: Second component of the vector defining the element orientation.
orientation3: Third component of the vector defining the element orientation.
stationRatio: Position of the station expressed as a fraction of the member length.
stationNonStructMass: Additional mass per unit member length at this station.
directionX: X component of the specified direction vector in its reference frame.
directionY: Y component of the specified direction vector in its reference frame.
directionZ: Z component of the specified direction vector in its reference frame.
xCoord: X coordinate of the location in the specified frame.
yCoord: Y coordinate of the location in the specified frame.
zCoord: Z coordinate of the location in the specified frame.
phase: Phase of the harmonic quantity relative to the reference oscillation.
smoothing: Selects the treatment of variation between adjacent table samples.
thermalConductivity: Heat flow per unit area per unit temperature gradient.
specificHeatPressure: Heat capacity per unit mass at constant pressure.
specificHeatVolume: Heat capacity per unit mass at constant volume.
cutoffFrequency: Frequency at which the specified range of the response ends (inverse time).
densityTableId: Identifier of the table supplying density as a function of its independent variable.
structuralDampingTableId: Identifier of the table supplying the structural damping coefficient.
referenceNode: Identifier of the grid point serving as the reference for this definition.
controlNode: Identifier of the grid point through which this definition is controlled.
entryLabel: User label associated with the entry.
variableCount: Number of independent variables used in the definition.
components: Degrees of freedom selected at the associated points. For structural grid points, digits 1–3 denote translations and 4–6 denote rotations.
timeStep: Time increment between successive states, in model time units.
lowerBound: Lower limit expressed in the same units as the bounded quantity.
upperBound: Upper limit expressed in the same units as the bounded quantity.
initialValue: Starting value of the quantity before an update or iteration.
designVarMoveLimit: Limits the change allowed for this design variable in one optimization update.
discreteValuesId: Identifier of the DesignDiscreteValues list of admissible values.
failureTheory: Selects the criterion used to evaluate failure from the material response.
laminateOption: Selects how the supplied ply sequence defines the laminate.
reservedValue: Optional value retained at a reserved position when the record is read and written.
